title: India IIP contributions by use-based category
description: Contributions of the six use-based categories to general IIP y/y, pp, 2022-23 base, monthly from April 2024: weight x (index - index a year earlier) / general index a year earlier, MoSPI's 2022-23 use-based weights, calculated; general_yoy is MoSPI's published rate. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/iip/in_iip_use_contrib.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly IIP release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
